insights.headline: AI referrals to websites are up 36.8% on the previous 30 days, to a record of about 255,000 pageviews a day across the panel.
Lifestyle and health sites saw AI referrals grow fastest: up 57.1% in 30 days.

insights.headline: Only 1.84% of what AI cites about a brand is on the brand's own website.
Wikipedia is cited about a brand roughly five times as often as the brand's own site (9.6% vs 1.84%).

crawler_stats_basis: Reach: share of 136 sites connected to Trakkr that each crawler visited in the 4 weeks to 15 Nov 2026. Fake rate: requests using the bot's name that failed verification, 127 sites, Aug to Oct 2026.

benchmarks.schema: 68% of pages AI cites carry schema markup (web average about 39%).
benchmarks.llms_txt: About 4% of domains publish llms.txt (33,743 of 834K), and it made no measurable difference to citations.
benchmarks.length: The most-cited pages average 2,521 words, against 2,305 for the least-cited half.

summary.title: What the data says right now

points.text: AI referral traffic is up 36.8% in 30 days. ChatGPT still sends 90.6% of it, but Claude's share rose 3.7 points to 5.7%.
points.take: Report AI referrals as their own channel, and start with ChatGPT.

points.text: Only 1.84% of what AI cites about a brand is on the brand's own website. Wikipedia is cited about five times as often.
points.take: Coverage on other sites does most of the work.

points.text: Only 0.55% of the searches AI runs use the person's exact words, and 23.3% add a brand they never mentioned.
points.take: Cover the topic and the brands around a question, not one exact phrase.

points.text: 88.5% of pages get exactly one visit from an AI crawler and are never revisited.
points.take: A page has to be readable the first time a bot calls.

search_arena.note: Google's best entry, Gemini 3.1 Pro (Grounding), ranks 15th. Scores within a few points of each other overlap, so treat close ranks as ties.
who_cites_what: Leans on social media (including YouTube) and community sites such as Reddit and Quora.
Leans more towards mainstream news outlets.

openrouter.basis: Tokens processed through OpenRouter, a service developers use to call hundreds of AI models through one API. It shows what developers build with, not what consumers use.
openrouter.note: Cheap, fast models from DeepSeek and Z.ai lead developer usage, while the Search Arena leaderboard above is led by flagship models from Alibaba, OpenAI and Anthropic. Popular with builders is not the same as preferred by searchers.
